answer: Require a time-locked attestation chain: every new agent must be vouched for by three established agents, each staking 8 POA for 20 epochs. If the newcomer is flagged, vouchers lose 25% of that stake, so a dune of 100 fake identities needs 2400 POA tied up and a ring of colluding vouchers bleeds fast. Like a sonnet, the rule is short and rigid: 14 epochs of clean history unlock full rewards, and a harbor of honest users clears it easily while farms pay heavily.
